name: 3.2mm Ferromagnetic Tungsten Dart FTD-3
description:
The FTD-3 is a sub-caliber ferromagnetic dart designed for the Variable Impedance Rifle VIR-9, engineered to perform across the weapon's full 12-stage impedance range from subsonic stealth shots to hypervelocity anti-materiel penetration. The dart is a solid tungsten-alloy needle with a ferromagnetic core that interacts with the VIR-9's electromagnetic coil array, allowing the weapon to precisely control muzzle velocity from stage to stage without requiring different ammunition types.

The ferromagnetic core is the critical component — a proprietary Tessera Corponation alloy that maintains consistent magnetic responsiveness across a velocity range of 80 m/s to 2,400 m/s. At low impedance stages, the dart exits the barrel at subsonic velocities with minimal acoustic signature, suitable for covert elimination at close range. At maximum impedance, the same dart achieves hypervelocity speeds that defeat most personal armor through sheer kinetic energy. The dart's flight characteristics change dramatically across this range: at low speeds it flies like a conventional flechette, at high speeds it behaves more like a railgun projectile with minimal drop over distance.

The darts are packaged in 15-round sealed magazines with integral humidity control, as the ferromagnetic core is susceptible to oxidation that degrades its magnetic responsiveness. Field storage beyond 30 days in unsealed conditions can reduce maximum-impedance performance by up to 15%, which has led to a practice among experienced VIR-9 operators of cycling their magazine stock frequently and disposing of rounds that have been exposed to atmosphere for extended periods.
specifications:
weight_per_round: 4.2g
muzzle_velocity: 80–2,400 m/s (impedance dependent)
penetration_rating: Stage 1-4: soft targets only / Stage 5-8: standard body armor / Stage 9-12: Class IV armor and light vehicle plating
effective_against: Variable by impedance — personnel at all stages, armored targets at high impedance, light vehicles at maximum
countermeasures: Magnetic deflection fields (partial at high impedance), spaced composite armor, active defense systems at lower velocities
variants: FTD-3 AP (hardened tip, optimized for stages 8-12, reduced low-impedance accuracy)
FTD-3 Subsonic (optimized for stages 1-4, enhanced flight stability at low velocity, incompatible above stage 6)
FTD-3 Tracer (electromagnetic signature emitter, trackable by compatible optics)
FTD-3 Frangible (breaks up on hard surface impact, reduced ricochet, stages 1-7 only)
cultural_context: The FTD-3 is one of the most versatile ammunition types in circulation, which makes it both popular and logistically demanding. Tessera Corponation's proprietary ferromagnetic alloy is not reproducible by third-party manufacturers — every attempt to reverse-engineer it has produced darts that either fail to respond consistently to the coil array or shatter at high impedance stages. This gives Tessera a monopoly on VIR-9 ammunition that they enforce aggressively through both legal channels and less official means. On the black market, genuine FTD-3 darts command a premium, and counterfeit detection is a cottage industry among street armorers who have learned to test magnetic responsiveness with improvised coil rigs.
story_hooks: A batch of counterfeit FTD-3 darts has entered the Kessler District black market — they perform adequately at low impedance but shatter in the barrel at stage 9 and above, and the operator who sold them has disappeared.

Tessera Corponation's ferromagnetic alloy formula was reportedly stolen in a corporate espionage operation — the thief is now being hunted by Tessera's internal security, two rival corponations, and three separate black market manufacturing syndicates.
